question: The FAB (antibody fragments that bind antigens) are used as antidotes to poisoning by:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: FAB binds to digoxin -> prevents digoxin from exerting toxic effects -> used as an antidote to digoxin poisoning -> 95%
CHAIN: FAB binds to barbiturates -> neutralizes the toxic effects of barbiturates -> used as an antidote to barbiturate poisoning -> 90%
CHAIN: FAB binds to salicylates -> inhibits the toxic effects of salicylates -> used as an antidote to salicylate poisoning -> 90%
analysis: FAB (antibody fragments that bind antigens) are used as antidotes in cases of poisoning by certain substances. Among the options provided, FAB fragments are commonly used as an antidote for poisoning by salicylates.
